name: Handout 11a: Gladius of Achilles
player_description:
GLADIUS OF ACHILLES
Taken from a hero who chose glory over survival.

Benefit: +2 weapon, advantage on attack rolls.
Cost: Vulnerability to piercing damage (the price of arrogance).
gm_notes:
WHEN: Session 5, Scene 2. Place face-down. Flip face-up when party can examine. Claimed as bonus action.
HOW: One index card per weapon. Include benefit AND cost so choices feel immediate.
MECHANICS NOTE: The vulnerability applies for the rest of the session after claiming. It is not a permanent curse — it is a test. A character who unclaims it (drops it mid-combat) loses both benefit and cost immediately.
